item.description:
This is the summary of my example work. It’s in a quote block.

I can also do nested quote blocks.

I can nest them as deep as I want.

author’s note Here is my author’s note. It’s in a HTML details block.

Fic goes here! Make sure to set draft = false in the frontmatter, or it won’t show up.

This fic is in a series, "series_1". The series_weight setting in the frontmatter tells Hugo what position to put it in on the series page. If you don’t set series_weight, Hugo will sort by date.

item.title: example work 2
item.author: YOUR EMAIL (YOUR NAME)
item.description:
Summary

This is the summary for my example multichapter work.

Here I can write some fic-wide author’s notes for the multichapter work, like warnings and links to the fic playlist.

Note that I’ve put multichapter = true in the frontmatter. My theme uses this to change the chapter header layout so you can switch between chapters.
